review_candidates.description_excerpt: The MongoDB Developer will design, implement, and maintain MongoDB databases to support high-performance, scalable applications. Daily responsibilities include modeling data structures, writing efficient queries, optimizing indexes, and managing database performance and security. The role involves collaborating with backend and frontend developers to integrate databases with application layers, troubleshooting issues, and implementing best practices for data integrity and reliability.
